patterns.note: Full-bleed video and image sections create an immersive experience, often with text overlaid directly on the media, breaking the traditional content box layout.
Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used for feature sections, pairing a large, impactful image with a concise text block, often with a subtle background color shift.
A distinctive light mint green (#E8F1EF) is used as a primary background color for several key sections, providing a unique brand identity that contrasts with dark grey/black text and imagery.
A sticky header navigation transitions from transparent with white text and logo to a solid light background with dark text and logo upon scroll, maintaining visibility and brand presence.
The hero video acts as a fixed background element that scrolls under the main content, creating a parallax-like effect as foreground elements overlay and reveal new content.
Feature sections often highlight specific locations or aspects of the service using a grid of images with short descriptive text, presented on a contrasting background.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video as a background element, which remains fixed or scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, allowing text and other elements to scroll over it, creating a dynamic visual depth.

A global navigation bar is initially transparent and overlays the hero content, then transforms into a solid, light-colored bar with dark text and logo once the user scrolls past the hero section, maintaining its position at the top of the viewport.
Content sections are revealed with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth visual flow and guiding the user's attention down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels for navigation and subheadings.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) on buttons and some image containers, but many elements, especially full-bleed media, maintain sharp edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, especially in hero and main content sections, with generous vertical spacing between major content blocks to enhance readability and visual breathing room.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a custom light mint green as a primary brand color, combined with the seamless integration of the robotaxi itself into the visual design through high-quality video and imagery, makes it feel both futuristic and approachable. The hero video acting as a background that content scrolls over is particularly effective in creating an immersive experience.
